import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    bitCoins = int(data[1])
    values = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    cost_frequency = {}
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if values[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if odd == even:
            diff = abs(values[i + 1] - values[i])
            cost_frequency[diff] = cost_frequency.get(diff, 0) + 1
    
    count = 0
    for cost in sorted(cost_frequency.keys()):
        freq = cost_frequency[cost]
        while freq > 0 and cost <= bitCoins:
            bitCoins -= cost
            count += 1
            freq -= 1
        if cost > bitCoins:
            break
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
